info.name: Eka ABDM Connect
info.description:
Every ABDM Connect API and callback, in the order of the docs sidebar (112 requests).

1. Import the sandbox environment and fill in client_id and client_secret.
2. Run Authentication > Connect Login. It saves access_token for every other request.
3. Work through a milestone top to bottom. Each response's txn_id, request_id, order_id, provider_id and X-token (token) are saved for the steps after it.

Callback requests post the payload Eka sends to {{webhook_url}}, so you can test your own receiver.

Docs: https://developer.eka.care/api-reference/user-app/abdm-connect/overview
